message:
Yen receipts now render correctly (`Paid ¥500 by card`), and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It always divides by 100, so a yen amount of 500 came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so the amount is already in whole yen.

I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` rather than in `formatMoney`. The Fenceline config limits this task to `src/payments`, and `formatMoney` is also used by invoices, the cart and admin. `receipt.js` now formats JPY as whole units itself and passes every other currency to `formatMoney` as before.

The same bug will still show up in invoices, the cart and admin for yen amounts. A fix in `money.js` would cover all of them. Want me to make it there?
